full_text_en:
Xiamen Aviation Development Co., Ltd. v. Beijing Nangang Jinyi Trade Co., Ltd. and Third Party: Xiamen Dongfanglong Metal Materials Co., Ltd. — Dispute over Sales Contract

[Ruling Summary]

The provisions before the proviso of Article 402 of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China apply only to pure principal-agent relationships. In practice, legal relationships arising from principal-agent contracts often involve not merely the agency relationship but also multiple legal relationships such as sale, loan, and guarantee. In such circumstances, if the provisions before the proviso of Article 402 of the Contract Law are applied simplistically, the legitimate rights and interests of the principal may be harmed. Therefore, the overall circumstances of the case should be comprehensively considered, careful deliberation should be made, and the provisions of Article 402 of the Contract Law should be correctly applied.

Civil Ruling of the Supreme People's Court

(2014) Min Shen Zi No. 2225

Re-applicant (Defendant at First Instance, Appellee at Second Instance): Beijing Nangang Jinyi Trade Co., Ltd. Domicile: No. 75 Xinhua North Street, Tongzhou District, Beijing.

Legal Representative: Fei [redacted], Chairman of the Board of the company.

Agent ad litem: Zhou Liang, lawyer of Jiangsu Yicheng Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Huang Fusong, lawyer of Jiangsu Yicheng Law Firm.

Respondent (Plaintiff at First Instance, Appellant at Second Instance): Xiamen Aviation Development Co., Ltd. Domicile: North side, middle section, 10th Floor, No. 222 Gaoqi South Fifth Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

Legal Representative: Kuang Xiaoping, Chairman of the Board of the company.

Agent ad litem: Tang Lijun, lawyer of Beijing Jingdu Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Liu Luhua, lawyer of Fujian Tianyi Law Firm.

Third Party at First Instance: Xiamen Dongfanglong Metal Materials Co., Ltd. Domicile: Units 01-02, 4th Floor, Building B, Yucheng Mansion, No. 51 Dongdu Road, Huli District, Xiamen, Fujian Province.

Legal Representative: Li Jianfu, Chairman of the Board of the company.

The re-applicant, Beijing Nangang Jinyi Trade Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Nangang Jinyi Company), dissatisfied with the civil judgment (2014) Min Min Zhong Zi No. 388 rendered by the Fujian High People's Court in the case of dispute over a sales contract with the respondent, Xiamen Aviation Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Xiamen Aviation Development Company), and the third party at first instance, Xiamen Dongfanglong Metal Materials Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Dongfanglong Metal Company), applied to this Court for retrial. This Court lawfully formed a collegial panel to examine this case, and the examination has now been concluded.

Nangang Jinyi Company applied for retrial, alleging: (1) The second instance judgment confused the three legal identities of Xiamen Aviation Development Company in the "Principal-Agent Agreement" and determined that it had an independent buyer status under the "Steel Products Sales and Purchase Contract," which constituted a serious finding of unclear facts. The "Principal-Agent Agreement" was in fact a contract containing three different legal relationships between Dongfanglong Metal Company and Xiamen Aviation Development Company: principal-agent procurement of steel, loan, and guarantee. It was not a pure "principal-agent" contract as its name suggested. The three different legal relationships could not be conflated, and even less could the legal status of Xiamen Aviation Development Company be characterized as an independent buyer based on these three different legal relationships. (2) The second instance judgment denied the legal consequence that Nangang Jinyi Company directly delivered goods to the undisclosed principal, Dongfanglong Metal Company, pursuant to Article 402 of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Contract Law), which constituted an error in the application of the law. The second instance judgment excluded the application of Article 402 of the Contract Law on the grounds that Nangang Jinyi Company knew that Xiamen Aviation Development Company had advanced the payment and should have known the agreement of "delivery upon payment," and denied the legal effect of Nangang Jinyi Company's delivery to Dongfanglong Metal Company by invoking the "proviso" of that Article. This was a misinterpretation of the provisions of that Article. (3) The second instance judgment found that Nangang Jinyi Company knew that Xiamen Aviation Development Company had advanced the payment and should have known the terms "delivery upon payment" and "title to the goods belongs to Xiamen Aviation Development Company before delivery," and accordingly imposed on Nangang Jinyi Company the obligation to ensure that Xiamen Aviation Development Company recovered its payment. This deviated from the objective facts. (4) The second instance judgment resulted in Xiamen Aviation Development Company obtaining a right to a double judgment for the same loss, which seriously violated the most fundamental principle of fairness. This judgment could not coexist with the prior judgment. The effective judgment (2013) Xia Min Chu Zi No. 156 rendered by the Xiamen Intermediate People's Court had already ordered Dongfanglong Metal Company and others to bear liability for compensation, and that judgment had already taken effect. Nangang Jinyi Company applied for retrial pursuant to Items (2) and (6) of Article 200 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

Xiamen Aviation Development Company submitted written opinions, arguing: (1) The second instance judgment found that Xiamen Aviation Development Company enjoyed independent buyer status under the "Steel Products Sales and Purchase Contract," with clear facts and sufficient grounds. (2) The "Steel Products Sales and Purchase Contract" in this case only bound Nangang Jinyi Company and Xiamen Aviation Development Company. Whether or not Nangang Jinyi Company's claim that it had directly delivered the goods to Dongfanglong Metal Company was established, it did not exempt Nangang Jinyi Company from the civil liability it should bear for breach of contract under the "Steel Products Sales and Purchase Contract." (3) The lawsuit filed by Xiamen Aviation Development Company in this case did not involve the issue of obtaining a double judgment right or receiving duplicate compensation. (4) During the performance of the "Steel Products Sales and Purchase Contract," Nangang Jinyi Company violated the principle of good faith and should bear corresponding civil liability. Nangang Jinyi Company's application for retrial lacked factual and legal basis and should be dismissed.

This Court is of the opinion that the main issue involved in the examination of this retrial application is whether Nangang Jinyi Company should refund the disputed payment and corresponding interest to Xiamen Aviation Development Company.

First, during the performance of the principal-agent contract and sales contract prior to the transaction in question, Dongfanglong Metal Company's actual taking delivery of goods was premised on Nangang Jinyi Company issuing a "Delivery Notice Letter" to Xiamen Aviation Development Company, and Xiamen Aviation Development Company issuing a "Goods Release Note" to Nangang Jinyi Company, informing it that the title to the goods had been transferred to Dongfanglong Metal Company. As regards the transaction in question, based on the facts found at first and second instance, Nangang Jinyi Company was actually aware of the contents in the "Principal-Agent Agreement" between Dongfanglong Metal Company and Xiamen Aviation Development Company, namely, "Dongfanglong Metal Company's taking delivery of goods shall follow the principle of delivery upon payment," and "Before delivery, the ownership of the goods belongs to Xiamen Aviation Development Company." Without the knowledge of Xiamen Aviation Development Company, Nangang Jinyi Company delivered the goods directly to Dongfanglong Metal Company through a third party, which actually harmed the interests of Xiamen Aviation Development Company. Second, the provisions of Article 402 of the Contract Law concerning the principal's right of intervention are generally limited to pure principal-agent relationships. However, this case, in addition to the principal-agent relationship, also involves multiple legal relationships such as sale, loan, and guarantee, particularly the guarantee relationship. To ensure the safety of its loaned funds, Xiamen Aviation Development Company specifically stipulated in the "Steel Products Sales and Purchase Contract" signed with Nangang Jinyi Company that the place of delivery (taking delivery) was at the supplier's warehouse, and the method was that the supplier would transfer the title to the goods to the demander. Therefore, after Xiamen Aviation Development Company paid Nangang Jinyi Company, the ownership of the steel delivered by Nangang Jinyi Company belonged to Xiamen Aviation Development Company. Without the knowledge of the owner Xiamen Aviation Development Company, Nangang Jinyi Company delivered the steel stipulated in the contract to Dongfanglong Metal Company. This delivery does not have the legal effect of delivery having been made to Xiamen Aviation Development Company. Accordingly, under the premise that Xiamen Aviation Development Company had actually advanced a huge amount of payment for Dongfanglong Metal Company, and given that Nangang Jinyi Company knew of this fact, if Article 402 of the Contract Law were applied simplistically (without applying the proviso of that Article), excluding the right of the buyer Xiamen Aviation Development Company under the sales relationship to demand the seller Nangang Jinyi Company to return the payment, this would clearly harm the rights of Xiamen Aviation Development Company and would not conform to the legislative intent of that Article. This case should apply the proviso of that Article. That is, the above-stipulated contents of the "Steel Products Sales and Purchase Contract" and the fact that Nangang Jinyi Company knew that Dongfanglong Metal Company had financed the transaction through Xiamen Aviation Development Company constitute "conclusive evidence" as provided in the proviso of Article 402 of the Contract Law. Therefore, the "Steel Products Sales and Purchase Contract" only binds Xiamen Aviation Development Company and Nangang Jinyi Company. Finally, this Court is of the opinion that Dongfanglong Metal Company actually received the steel in question but did not pay the price. It is the ultimate responsible party. After Nangang Jinyi Company bears liability in this case, it may seek recourse against Dongfanglong Metal Company. Additionally, since the effective civil judgment (2013) Xia Min Chu Zi No. 156 rendered by the Xiamen Intermediate People's Court has already ordered Dongfanglong Metal Company and others to repay the advanced payment and interest to Xiamen Aviation Development Company, this judgment should be coordinated with that case during the enforcement process to avoid Xiamen Aviation Development Company receiving duplicate compensation.

In conclusion, Nangang Jinyi Company's application for retrial does not meet the circumstances specified in Items (2) and (6) of Article 200 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China. Pursuant to Paragraph 1 of Article 204 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, this Court rules as follows:

The application for retrial by Beijing Nangang Jinyi Trade Co., Ltd. is dismissed.

Presiding Judge: Yang Yongqing

Acting Judge: Wu Jingli

Acting Judge: Zhang Xiaojie

October 20, 2015

Clerk: Hao Jinqi
